hooks/useConfiguratorShare.ts.name: Share a build
hooks/useConfiguratorShare.ts.description: Creates a shareable link that captures the customer's exact ring configuration so they can send it to someone.

hooks/useFadeInOnScroll.ts.name: Fade-in animation
hooks/useFadeInOnScroll.ts.description: Makes page sections gently appear as the customer scrolls down to them.

hooks/useKeyboardNavigation.ts.name: Keyboard navigation
hooks/useKeyboardNavigation.ts.description: Lets customers use the keyboard to move through menus, galleries and dropdowns for better accessibility.

hooks/useParallax.ts.name: Parallax effect
hooks/useParallax.ts.description: Makes background images move at a different speed from the text, creating a sense of depth as the customer scrolls.

hooks/usePerformance.ts.name: Speed monitoring
hooks/usePerformance.ts.description: Tracks how fast pages load and reports performance numbers so slow spots can be found and fixed.

hooks/useRecentlyViewed.ts.name: Recently viewed tracker
hooks/useRecentlyViewed.ts.description: Remembers which products a customer has looked at and fetches their details for the recently-viewed section.

hooks/useReducedMotion.ts.name: Reduced motion check
hooks/useReducedMotion.ts.description: Detects when a customer has asked their device to reduce animations and turns off motion effects.

hooks/useScrollReveal.ts.name: Scroll reveal
hooks/useScrollReveal.ts.description: Triggers entrance animations on elements as they scroll into view, adding polish to the browsing experience.

hooks/useStaggerChildren.ts.name: Staggered entrance
hooks/useStaggerChildren.ts.description: Makes a group of items appear one after another with a slight delay, giving product grids a flowing entrance.

hooks/useWishlist.ts.name: Wishlist tracker
hooks/useWishlist.ts.description: Keeps track of which products the customer has saved as favourites across the whole site.
